question: Should OpenClaw advance the global shared SQLite schema to v5 for local marketplace-watch state, or should this capability be deferred or moved behind a different ownership boundary?
rationale: Repository policy reserves SQLite schema-version bumps for explicit acceptance, and the contributor explicitly identifies this decision as unresolved.

options.title: Sponsor shared-state v5
options.body: Approve marketplace watches as core shared state and require the PR to preserve the documented doctor upgrade path and support policy.

options.title: Defer or relocate the feature
options.body: Do not advance the global schema until maintainers choose a plugin-owned or otherwise narrower persistence boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor shared-state v5
recommendation.body: Approve marketplace watches as core shared state and require the PR to preserve the documented doctor upgrade path and support policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available low-confidence routing candidate for an explicit core storage-contract decision.
